questions.q: Lactose used in trituration should be:
opts: pure sugar of milk, free from starch and other sugars
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Purity standards are set in the HPI.

questions.q: The first aid to stop external bleeding from a limb wound is:
opts: washing the wound with hot water
applying a cold drink to the lips
firm direct pressure over the wound with a clean pad
questions.why: Direct pressure with elevation stops most external haemorrhage; a tourniquet is a last resort.

questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Used to estimate time since death.

questions.q: Globules used in homoeopathy are made of:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Sugar-of-milk is used for triturations and tablets; globules are cane sugar.

questions.q: The Korsakovian method of potentisation uses:
opts: a single vial, emptied and refilled at each step
a new vial at each step
a continuous flow of water through the vial
questions.why: Korsakoff's method uses one vial throughout; the Hahnemannian method uses a fresh vial for each potency.

questions.q: Heat intolerance, weight loss with good appetite, tremor and exophthalmos suggest:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Thyroid overactivity.

questions.q: A weak, empty, sinking feeling in the stomach at about 11 a.m. is a keynote of:
questions.why: Sulphur: faint, empty, weak feeling at 11 a.m. (Allen's Keynotes); Natrum mur is worse at 10 a.m.

questions.q: A raised eosinophil count is typically seen in:
Chickenpox with intensely itching vesicles, restlessness and relief from warmth and motion calls for:
questions.why: Rhus tox suits vesicular eruptions with intense itching and restlessness, better from warmth, as in chickenpox and herpes zoster.
